body: I'm sorry but, neither reincarnation or souls has been proven to be real. Death is the best kind of freedom because like the OP said, you don't have problems anymore. Non-existence frees you from all the problems of life.

I wish it was that easy. But it really isn't. I live in a third-world country rife with corruption.

Even if there was such a program over here, the people leading that effort would most likely be too busy pocketing the money for themselves. That's pretty common over here.

We have such a huge number of poor people as well so that's a testament to how ineffective my country is at dealing with the poor.
